stories.title: Saline residents voice fears over data center power and tax costs
stories.dek: Dozens packed a Saline coffee hour to question local leaders about proposed data centers. Residents focused on higher electric bills, water use, and lost tax revenue if big projects win breaks. The session showed how quickly the issue is becoming a flashpoint in Washtenaw County townships.
stories.source_title: Data Center Concerns Dominate Saline Coffee Hour - The Sun Times News

stories.title: Hyperscale Data sells $43M Bitcoin to bankroll Michigan data center push
stories.dek: The firm offloaded 685 BTC and cut debt by $30M, freeing cash specifically earmarked for its Michigan buildout. Michigan residents will feel the impact through added power demand, water use, and potential tax deals tied to the project. The move shows how crypto volatility now directly funds local infrastructure plans.
stories.source_title: Hyperscale Data Has Sold Approximately 685 Bitcoin for Approximately $43 Million, Reduces Debt by Approximately $30 Million and Strengthens Liquidity to Support Michigan Data Center Buildout - Bitcoin

stories.title: Palmyra residents push back on data center plans over power and noise fears
stories.dek: Neighbors in Lenawee County’s Palmyra Township voiced worries that proposed facilities would spike electric bills and create constant noise. Local officials heard the concerns during a public session focused on zoning changes. Anyone within 50 miles could face higher utility costs if the projects move forward without stricter limits.
stories.source_title: Palmyra residents weigh in on data centers - WITN

stories.title: Washtenaw data center projects advance under new local oversight
stories.dek: The Sun Times News weekly roundup shows oversight expanding in Washtenaw County as multiple data center proposals move forward. Residents 30 miles away feel the impact through rising power demand and potential tax deals. Local boards are tightening rules on size and location rather than waiting for state action.
stories.source_title: Weekly Data Center Watch: Local Oversight Expands as Projects Move Forward - The Sun Times News

stories.title: Vevay Twp landowners push Mason annexation to clear path for data center
stories.dek: Property owners in Vevay Township want their land moved into the city of Mason so a data center can move forward. The annexation would shift tax revenue and local control from the township to the city. Residents 30 miles away in Lansing or Jackson could see new power and water demand if the project advances.
stories.source_title: Vevay Township landowners seeking Mason annexation for data center - WILX

stories.title: Saline data center backer buys golf course next door
stories.dek: The developer behind a large proposed campus in Washtenaw County’s Saline Township has purchased the neighboring golf course. Residents worry the move signals bigger land use, power demand and tax-break requests ahead. Local officials have not yet said how the purchase affects pending reviews.
stories.source_title: Developer of controversial Saline Township data center buys neighboring golf course - CBS News

stories.title: Rogers: Halt new data centers to prevent higher power costs in Michigan
stories.dek: Former congressman Mike Rogers told Detroit voters he supports a temporary halt on new data centers. The stance comes as power demand from AI projects strains Michigan utilities and local grids. Residents 30 miles away could see higher electric bills if large facilities move forward without limits.
stories.source_title: Mike Rogers backs data center 'pause' at campaign stop in Detroit - The Detroit News

stories.title: Township blocks power lines to halt U-M backed hyperscale project
stories.dek: A Michigan township passed a ban on new electrical infrastructure to stop a 220,000-square-foot data center tied to the University of Michigan and Los Alamos National Laboratory. Residents face the prospect of massive power infrastructure serving a nuclear-weapons-linked facility without local say. The move directly affects nearby homes and farms by cutting off the project's grid connection.
stories.source_title: Michigan township combats nuclear weapons data center by passing ban on new electrical infrastructure — 220,000-square-foot hyperscale project is backed by University of Michigan and the Los Alamos Na

stories.title: OpenAI-Oracle developer snaps up golf course beside planned Michigan campus
stories.dek: The firm behind a massive proposed data center has purchased adjacent land once used as a golf course. The move signals intent to expand the footprint in the area despite local pushback. Nearby residents face questions about noise, traffic, and how much power the project will pull from the grid.
stories.source_title: Developer of controversial OpenAI, Oracle data center buys golf course next door - MLive.com

stories.title: New Buffalo Township rejects special land use for proposed data center site
stories.dek: The township board turned down a request to allow a data center on Kluver Road after hearing resident concerns. The denial keeps the project from advancing for now in this southwest Michigan community. Locals worry about water use and noise if similar proposals return.
stories.source_title: New Buffalo Township Board denies SLU for Kluver Road site - Harbor Country News

stories.title: Ypsilanti Township Board Approves Land-Use Moratorium Targeting Electric Infrastructure for Data Centers
stories.dek: Trustees unanimously passed the measure at their Aug. 18 meeting to limit major utility projects, directly affecting a proposed University of Michigan and Los Alamos National Laboratory research data center at Textile and Bridge roads.

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
